events_participant_role_prefix.name: events_participant_role_prefix
events_participant_role_prefix.value: ("events"."role" = 'learner' AND "events"."participant_id" LIKE 'L-%') OR ("events"."role" = 'mentor' AND "events"."participant_id" LIKE 'M-%') OR ("events"."role" = 'operator' AND "events"."participant_id" LIKE 'O-%')

events_reason_code_required.name: events_reason_code_required
events_reason_code_required.value: "events"."event_name" NOT IN ('decline_reason', 'no_show', 'safety_flag') OR "events"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL

participants_consent_order.name: participants_consent_order
participants_consent_order.value: "participants"."consent_withdrawn_at" IS NULL OR ("participants"."consent_given_at" IS NOT NULL AND "participants"."consent_withdrawn_at" >= "participants"."consent_given_at")

sessions_time_order.name: sessions_time_order
sessions_time_order.value: "sessions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "sessions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "sessions"."ends_at" > "sessions"."starts_at"

skill_evidence_verification_actor.name: skill_evidence_verification_actor
skill_evidence_verification_actor.value: ("skill_evidence"."verification_state" = 'pending' AND "skill_evidence"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "skill_evidence"."verified_by" IS NULL) OR ("skill_evidence"."verification_state" <> 'pending' AND "skill_evidence"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_evidence"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL)

state_transition_actor_consistency.name: state_transition_actor_consistency
state_transition_actor_consistency.value: ("state_transitions"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "state_transitions"."actor_participant_id" IS NULL) OR ("state_transitions"."actor_type" <> 'system' AND "state_transitions"."actor_participant_id" IS NOT NULL)
